title: Surrey cEEGrid sleep data set
description: This dataset comprises overnight sleep EEG recordings from 20 healthy participants, collected in spring 2017 as part of a wearable sleep monitoring study at the Surrey Clinical Research Centre. Recordings include full polysomnography (PSG) and around-the-ear cEEGrid measurements, with most subjects having both modalities recorded on the same night. The dataset supports comparison between conventional PSG and wearable cEEGrid sleep staging approaches.
methods_description: Participants underwent overnight sleep recordings with equipment mounted immediately prior to bedtime at the sleep laboratory of the Surrey Clinical Research Centre. Recordings consisted of full polysomnography (PSG) and/or around-the-ear cEEGrid EEG measurements, with no tasks performed by subjects during sleep. Alignment between cEEGrid and PSG recordings was not preserved during data collection, requiring post-hoc alignment processing shared as a derivative dataset ('aligned1').
